# Tendies Wallpaper

> Tendies Wallpaper is a curated collection of dynamic, animated lock-screen wallpapers for iPhone and iPad, installed via the open-source Nugget tool with a .tendies file format. No jailbreak is required, supporting iOS & iPadOS 17 through 27.

## Core Overview
- Official Project: https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/
- Official Wallpaper Library: https://tendieswallpaper.com/
- Tutorial & Guide: https://nugget.host/en/tutorial/nugget
- Open-Source Tool: https://nugget.host/ (by leminlimez)
- Package Format: .tendies (Apple PosterBoard restore bundle)
- System Compatibility: iOS 17 – 27, iPadOS 17 – 27
- Jailbreak Requirement: None (Safe restore via Apple SparseRestore / BookRestore protocols)

## Key Resources & Wallpapers Catalog
- [Wallpapers Hub Directory](https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/wallpapers/): Complete index of 60 FPS animated .tendies files.
- [Steel Ball Run JoJo Dynamic Wallpaper](https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/wallpapers/steel-ball-run-jojo-spin-spin/)
- [My Dress-Up Darling Marin Dynamic Wallpaper](https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/wallpapers/my-dress-up-darling-marin-six-shots/)
- [Lewis Hamilton F1 Dynamic Wallpaper](https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/wallpapers/f1-hamilton-sunglasses/)
- [Mushoku Tensei Sylphiette Dynamic Wallpaper](https://tendieswallpaper.github.io/wallpapers/mushoku-tensei-sylphiette-fitz/)
- [Step-by-Step Installation](https://nugget.host/en/tutorial/nugget): Complete guide to install .tendies wallpapers using Nugget.
- [Pricing & Access](https://tendieswallpaper.com/en/premium): Free and premium membership options.

## Technical Architecture
A `.tendies` file contains Apple PosterBoard lock screen descriptors:
1. posterboard: Native container files, asset catalogs, and wallpaper IDs.
2. descriptors: Randomized UUID plist entries restoring directly into Collections / Favorites.
3. suggested / mercury: Video and motion layers targeting native PosterBoard processes with 0% idle battery drain.
